subject: Add multiple labels specifications in scale_x_continuous

messages.author: fd85dcfa1373e737
messages.subject: Add multiple labels specifications in scale_x_continuous
parts:
Hi,

I wanted to add multiple label specifications in my plot. In my case i wanted to add the absolute and and suppress the scientific format.

I tried to add it twice, however, it will only use the last mentioned label specifications. Is there a way to combine the two. Attached is my code below. 
ggplot(mtcars,aes(x=disp, y= wt) )+
    geom_point()+
    scale_x_continuous(labels =abs, n.breaks = 10) +
  # scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE))

Thanks in advance,
Chido

messages.author: f806fceff479cfeb
messages.subject: Re: Add multiple labels specifications in scale_x_continuous
parts:
Hi Chido,

It's not completely clear to me what you are trying to achieve. As you have correctly noted, the second scales specification always replaces the earlier one. Maybe you want a second x-axis with different labels? You can do that and have one set of labels at the bottom and a second set of labels at the top, using the sec.axis option. For example:
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=disp, y= wt) )+
  geom_point()+
  scale_x_continuous(labels =abs, n.breaks = 10,  sec.axis = dup_axis(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = TRUE)))

Is this what you want?
